title: A hierarchical Bayesian pipeline for soliton-plus-NFW inference on SPARC rotation curves: diagnostics and prior-boundary behaviour
efc_relevance: Hierarchical Bayesian fit of soliton-plus-NFW (ultralight / fuzzy DM) profiles to the SPARC database, treating the core-halo scaling exponent as a global free parameter and explicitly mapping prior-boundary degeneracies. Provides a directly-comparable per-galaxy goodness-of-fit baseline for any EFC variant that predicts a galaxy rotation-curve shape from the entropy-flow term S(r,t): EFC must either match the soliton+NFW per-galaxy chi^2 or beat it, on the same SPARC subset, to remain a viable galactic-scale framework. Also tightens framework:FuzzyDM-Hu2000 discriminator by pinning the global core-halo scaling exponent.
ledger_action: Add to Validation Ledger as a SPARC galaxy-scale benchmark; update framework:FuzzyDM-Hu2000 row with the global core-halo exponent constraint; cross-reference arXiv:2411.13329 (BIG-SPARC); required follow-up in Predictions Ledger: replicate the hierarchical Bayesian pipeline with EFC's S(r,t) RC predictor on the same 175-galaxy SPARC subset and report per-galaxy chi^2 distribution against soliton+NFW.
